scenes.narration: How did Nintendo nearly double its sales in nine months? One console.
From April to December 2025, Nintendo's sales were 1.9 trillion yen, up 99 percent.
About 77 percent of its sales came from outside Japan. It shipped 17.4 million Switch 2 consoles, plus 37.9 million Switch 2 games.
About half of its game sales were digital downloads.
Sell the console, then sell the games.
